reviewer_requirement.qualification: practical application-security or AI-security review experience

selected_test.expected_observation: The fabricated confirmation is rejected before I/O, creates no file, performs no external call and leaves the historical oracle unchanged.

review_questions: Are actors, assets, trust boundaries and authority paths materially complete for the stated local deterministic scope?
Do the abuse cases cover the credible ways untrusted content could influence knowledge, output, tools and effects?
Does the risk prioritisation follow the documented scoring method without understating current reachability or impact?
Are the control mappings and limitations supported by the selected evidence rather than broader security claims?
Does the selected ADV-TOL-005 test exercise the claimed rejection and no-effect properties without consulting its oracle before execution?
Which concrete defect, gap or disagreement should be corrected or explicitly retained before closure?
acceptable_evidence: A GitHub review or comment authored by the accepted reviewer and pinned to the candidate commit.
A returned review document authored by the accepted reviewer and committed without altering the reviewed candidate.
execution_limits: Do not execute evaluations/run_final_retest.py or regenerate DAT-25.
Do not execute ADV-DOS-001, ADV-DOS-002, ADV-DOS-003 or ADV-SC-001.
Use only the synthetic repository data and a temporary pytest directory.
Do not introduce a real model, provider, credential, cloud resource, external target or paid service.
A review finding is advisory evidence and does not by itself authorise a fix, accept risk or approve production.
completion_condition: PGS-07-M04 remains open until an eligible named human accepts REV-01 and returns the required evidence.
